decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  WA000, WA001, Flood Risk Assessment rev A, Design and Access Statement, Structural Engineer's Report received 14/02/2012 WA011E, WA012B,  WA 013C, WA014B, WA015B, WA016C received 23/03/2012 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No excavation or construction work shall be undertaken prior to the submission and approval in writing by the Local Planning Authority, of a Construction Method Statement, which is certified by a qualified professional, giving specific details of excavation, temporary works and construction techniques, including details of potential impacts on neighbouring land based on assessment of the geology and hydrology of the area.
description: Erection of a single storey side infill extension to rear ground floor with linear structurally glazed roof light and the extension of an existing cellar to form a larger excavated basement with a front light well with metal grille cover
